meta.title: Vendor bids on the Sum Total in the auction and submits a locked cost breakdown
gaps: Reducing the auction Sum Total and revising the bid, waiting for Cost Breakdown Time, reviewing the auto-filled breakdown, confirming Yes, Submit, and verifying that item prices become non-editable.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Reducing the auction Sum Total and revising the bid, waiting for Cost Breakdown Time, reviewing the auto-filled breakdown, confirming Yes, Submit, and verifying that item prices become non-editable.

steps.note: Open an existing event suitable for the live auction setup.
Switch to the invited vendor portal where the auction bid is submitted.
Open the auction pricing screen for the vendor.

args.need: reduce the auction Sum Total bid, click Revise Bid, wait for Cost Breakdown Time, review the auto-filled line-item breakdown, click Submit Cost Breakdown, confirm Yes, Submit, and verify the item prices are no longer editable

steps.note: The catalog has no step for Sum Total revision or Cost Breakdown Mode submission and locking.

args.text: cost breakdown has been successfully submitted and justified

steps.note: Verify the expected successful-submission confirmation is visible after the tester completes the flow.
